T: Lamb for everyone. Even the vegetarian.
D: A thirty-year-old Greek-American woman in Chicago falls for a man who isn't Greek, and her huge, loud family has plenty to say about it.
P: Serve the snacks when Toula is pouring coffee at the family restaurant and Ian walks in.
S: crisp buttered filo filled with feta, ricotta, egg and mint, for the whole Portokalos clan

Crisp buttered filo triangles filled with feta, ricotta, egg and fresh mint. Heat the oven to 190C. Mix 200g crumbled feta, 100g ricotta, 1 egg, 1 tbsp chopped mint and plenty of black pepper. Brush a sheet of filo with melted butter, lay another on top, brush again and cut lengthways into 3 strips. Repeat with the rest of 8 sheets and 100g butter. Put a heaped teaspoon of filling at the end of each strip and fold over and over into a triangle, then brush the tops. Bake on lined trays for 20 minutes until crisp and golden and cool for 5 minutes before serving.
fried beef balls with mint and oregano, cool garlic cucumber yoghurt and lemon

Little fried Greek meatballs of beef, mint and oregano, with cool garlic and cucumber tzatziki and lemon. Mix 250g Greek yoghurt with 1 grated and squeezed Lebanese cucumber, 1 grated garlic clove, 1 tbsp lemon juice and 1 tbsp chopped dill and chill. Mix 500g beef mince, 1 grated small onion, 2 crushed garlic cloves, 50g fresh breadcrumbs soaked in 3 tbsp milk, 1 egg, 2 tbsp chopped mint, 1 tsp dried oregano, salt and pepper. Roll into walnut-sized balls and roll in 50g plain flour. Fry in batches in 125ml olive oil over medium high heat for about 6 minutes, turning, until browned and cooked through. Drain and serve hot with the tzatziki and lemon wedges.
M: Nick's chicken souvlaki and village salad
Lemon oregano chicken skewers, pita and horiatiki

Toula's brother Nick on the grill out the back of Dancing Zorba's, making enough for the whole family and then some. Marinate 800g chicken thigh chunks in the juice of a lemon, 3 tbsp olive oil, 3 garlic cloves, 2 tsp oregano and salt for at least 1 hour. Thread onto skewers and grill 10 to 12 minutes, turning, until charred. Grate half a cucumber into 200g Greek yoghurt with lemon and salt. Cut the rest of the cucumber, 3 tomatoes, half a red onion and a green capsicum into chunks, add olives and a slab of feta, and dress with oil and oregano. Warm 4 pitas on the grill.
Gus's front-yard lamb with lemon potatoes
butterflied leg in lemon, garlic and oregano, charred, with roast lemon potatoes

Butterflied lamb leg in lemon, garlic and oregano, charred on the barbecue, with roasted Greek lemon potatoes. Mix 80ml olive oil, the juice of 2 lemons, 4 crushed garlic cloves, 1 tbsp dried oregano and 1 tsp salt, rub all over a 1.8kg butterflied lamb leg and marinate in the fridge for 2 hours. Heat the oven to 220C. Toss 1.2kg potato wedges in a roasting tin with 60ml olive oil, the juice of 2 lemons, 2 sliced garlic cloves and 1 tsp oregano, pour in 250ml chicken stock and roast for 1 hour, turning twice, until golden and the liquid has gone. Meanwhile heat a barbecue to high and cook the lamb for 10 to 12 minutes a side until charred outside and pink inside, then rest under foil for 15 minutes. Carve thickly and serve with the potatoes and pan juices.
W: nut, orange and cinnamon butter sponge soaked in sticky citrus syrup

Walnut, orange and cinnamon butter cake baked in a ring tin and soaked in honey orange syrup. Heat the oven to 170C and butter and flour a 24cm Bundt tin. Beat 200g soft butter with 200g caster sugar until pale, then beat in 4 eggs one at a time with the zest of 1 orange. Fold in 250g self-raising flour, 1 tsp ground cinnamon, 150g chopped walnuts and 125g Greek yoghurt, spoon into the tin and bake for 45 minutes. Meanwhile simmer 200g caster sugar, 200ml water, 3 tbsp honey, the juice of 2 oranges and a cinnamon stick for 5 minutes, then cool. Cool the cake in the tin for 10 minutes, turn out and spoon the cool syrup slowly over the hot cake. Leave to soak for 30 minutes before slicing.
K: Instant coffee shaken to a thick foam, poured over ice and topped with cold milk

Instant coffee and sugar shaken to a thick foam, poured over ice and topped with cold milk. Shake 4 tsp instant coffee, 4 tsp caster sugar and 120ml cold water hard in a sealed jar for 1 minute until thick and pale. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice, spoon in the coffee foam and slowly top each with 100ml cold milk. Serve with a straw.

dishes.make_ahead: Fold and freeze the unbaked triangles on a tray up to 1 month ahead; bake from frozen for 5 minutes longer

steps.text: Heat the oven to 190C and line 2 trays. Mix the feta, ricotta, egg, mint and a good grind of pepper.
Lay out 1 filo sheet, brush with butter, lay a second on top and brush again. Cut lengthways into 3 strips. Repeat with the rest.
Put a heaped teaspoon of filling at the end of each strip and fold over and over into a triangle. Brush the tops with butter.
Bake until crisp and golden.
Cool for 5 minutes before serving.

dishes.make_ahead: Roll the keftedes up to 1 day ahead and chill on a tray; make the tzatziki up to 2 days ahead; fry to serve

ingredients.item: Lebanese cucumber, grated and squeezed dry
garlic clove, grated, for the tzatziki
lemon juice, plus wedges to serve

steps.text: Mix the yoghurt, cucumber, grated garlic, lemon juice and dill for the tzatziki and chill.
Mix the beef mince, onion, crushed garlic, breadcrumbs, milk, egg, mint and oregano with salt and pepper.
Roll into walnut-sized balls and roll them in the flour.
Fry in batches in the oil over medium high heat, turning, until browned and cooked through.
Drain on paper towel and serve hot with the tzatziki and lemon wedges.

veg.n: Dancing Zorba's zucchini keftedes with tzatziki
veg.make_ahead: Grate and salt the zucchini and make the tzatziki up to 1 day ahead; mix and fry to serve

ingredients.item: Lebanese cucumber, grated and squeezed dry
garlic clove, grated, for the tzatziki
lemon juice, plus wedges to serve

steps.text: Toss the zucchini with the salt in a colander and leave to drain.
Mix the yoghurt, cucumber, grated garlic, lemon juice and dill for the tzatziki and chill.
Squeeze the zucchini hard in a clean tea towel, then mix with the feta, spring onions, breadcrumbs, egg, mint, oregano and pepper.
Shape into walnut-sized balls, flatten slightly and roll in the flour.
Fry in batches in the oil over medium heat until golden on both sides.
Drain on paper towel and serve hot with the tzatziki and lemon wedges.

dishes.n: Gus's front-yard lamb with lemon potatoes
dishes.make_ahead: Marinate the lamb up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; cut the potatoes up to 4 hours ahead and keep in cold water

ingredients.item: garlic cloves, crushed, for the lamb
garlic cloves, sliced, for the potatoes

steps.text: Mix the olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, oregano and salt for the lamb, rub all over the lamb and leave to marinate.
Marinate in the fridge, then bring back to room temperature.
Heat the oven to 220C. Toss the potatoes in a roasting tin with the potato oil, lemon juice, garlic and oregano and pour in the stock.
Roast the potatoes, turning twice, until golden and the liquid has gone.
Meanwhile heat a barbecue to high and cook the lamb for 10 to 12 minutes a side until charred outside and pink inside.
Rest the lamb under foil for 15 minutes.
Carve thickly and serve with the lemon potatoes and the pan juices.

veg.n: Gus's front-yard haloumi souvlaki with lemon potatoes
veg.make_ahead: Marinate the vegetables up to 4 hours ahead; cut the potatoes up to 4 hours ahead and keep in cold water

ingredients.item: garlic cloves, crushed, for the skewers
garlic cloves, sliced, for the potatoes

steps.text: Mix the olive oil, lemon juice, garlic and oregano for the skewers and toss with the eggplant, capsicum and onion.
Leave the vegetables to marinate.
Heat the oven to 220C. Toss the potatoes in a roasting tin with the potato oil, lemon juice, garlic and oregano and pour in the stock.
Roast the potatoes, turning twice, until golden and the liquid has gone.
Meanwhile thread the haloumi and marinated vegetables onto the skewers.
Heat a barbecue to high and cook the skewers, turning and brushing with the leftover marinade, until charred.
Serve the skewers on the lemon potatoes with the pan juices.

dishes.n: Nick's chicken souvlaki and village salad
dishes.make_ahead: Marinate the chicken overnight and make the tzatziki up to 2 days ahead, both chilled; grill and make the salad on the night

steps.text: Marinate the chicken in the juice of a lemon, 3 tbsp of the oil, the garlic, half the oregano and salt for at least 1 hour.
Thread onto skewers and grill 10 to 12 minutes, turning, until charred and cooked through.
Grate half the cucumber, squeeze it dry and stir into the yoghurt with a squeeze of lemon and salt.
Cut the rest of the cucumber, the tomatoes, onion and capsicum into chunks, add the olives, top with the feta and dress with the last oil and oregano.
Warm the pitas on the grill and serve with the skewers, tzatziki and salad.

veg.n: Nick's haloumi souvlaki and village salad
veg.make_ahead: Marinate the haloumi overnight and make the tzatziki up to 2 days ahead, both chilled; grill and make the salad on the night

steps.text: Toss the zucchini and haloumi in the juice of a lemon, 3 tbsp of the oil, the garlic, half the oregano and pepper.
Thread onto skewers and grill 6 to 8 minutes, turning, until charred.
Grate half the cucumber, squeeze it dry and stir into the yoghurt with a squeeze of lemon and salt.
Cut the rest of the cucumber, the tomatoes, onion and capsicum into chunks, add the olives, top with the feta and dress with the last oil and oregano.
Warm the pitas on the grill and serve with the skewers, tzatziki and salad.

dishes.make_ahead: Bake and soak the cake up to 3 days ahead and keep it covered at room temperature

steps.text: Heat the oven to 170C and butter and flour a 24cm Bundt tin.
Beat the butter and cake sugar until pale and fluffy, then beat in the eggs one at a time with the orange zest.
Fold in the flour, cinnamon, walnuts and yoghurt and spoon into the tin.
Bake until a skewer comes out clean.
Meanwhile simmer the syrup sugar, water, honey, orange juice and cinnamon stick for 5 minutes, then cool.
Cool the cake in the tin for 10 minutes, turn out onto a plate and spoon the cool syrup slowly over the hot cake.
Leave to soak before slicing.

dishes.make_ahead: Chill the milk and glasses up to 1 day ahead; shake the coffee foam to order

steps.text: Shake the coffee, sugar and cold water hard in a sealed jar until it turns into a thick, pale foam.
Fill 4 tall glasses with the ice.
Spoon the coffee foam over the ice.
Top slowly with the cold milk and serve with a straw.
